inputs.text: Man, this Nigeria thing is straight out of the elites' playbook to rig democracy from the inside. Political parties like the APC aren't for regular people anymore—they're just gated clubs for the wealthy to hoard everything. Those latest moves ahead of the 2027 elections aren't random or some overlooked trend like they'd prefer we believe. It's a deliberate, coordinated operation to lock down the system, shut out ordinary citizens, and keep all the power concentrated at the top through lies and institutional takeover.
